note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (C = rows with t1_cap_hit true; RL right = t2_right true and t2_cap_hit not true) and studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/sft1_cue-01/per_problem.json (Think-SFT right = score_v3 == 1 and cap_hit not true; missing row or null score = not right). Both committed, first row per problem_index kept (no repeats seen). t2_right is stored as the integer 0/1, not JSON true/false; 1 is read as true. Statistic: signed integer sum over C of (SFT right - RL right); n = |C|; 90 % interval = bootstrap over C problems (each entry the pair of rows), recomputing the signed sum, so the interval also moves with how many C problems a resample holds. Ambiguity: the recipe is explicit; alt_measured drops the cap-hit conditions (right = t2_right true / score_v3 == 1 alone), in case 'right' was meant as the graded score only. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false.

Files: t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (kept = t1_right non-null and not (t1_right true and t1_cap_hit not true); C = kept with t1_cap_hit true, so a cap-hit row with t1_right 1 also lands in C; F = other kept), wsp1/full500/sft1_cue-01/per_problem.json (Think-SFT right as in k 4), day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl (k4 = over samples 0-3, the first attempt == 0 row per sample, counted right if score_v3 == 1 and not a cap hit; cap hit = cap_hit true, or cap_hit missing and finish_reason 'length'; every row has cap_hit). Strata 0, 1, 2, {3,4}; r_F per stratum from F; C problems whose stratum has no F problem are dropped; statistic = SFT-right fraction over remaining C minus mean of their strata's r_F. n reported = number of kept problems (C plus F), since the bootstrap resamples over all kept problems and recomputes r_F, the drop and both terms; a resample with no usable C problem (probability negligible) returns the full-sample value. t1_right is stored as 0/1, 1 read as true. Ambiguity: the recipe fixes attempt == 0; alt_measured computes k4 from each sample's last attempt (the outcome after up to 2 restarts), the other plausible meaning of the base's '4-sample count'. Strata are small (C about 27 problems), so the interval will be wide. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false.
